class.name: NNNQSSearchCriteria
class.brief_description: Base class for Node Query System (NQS) criteria that filter and score candidate nodes.
class.description: Add concrete [NNNQSSearchCriteria] nodes as children of an [NNNQSSearchSpaces] node to discard unwanted candidates ([member use_for_filtering]) and rank the remaining ones ([member use_for_scoring]). Optionally assign a [Curve] or [NNResponseCurve] to [member activation_curve] to shape how raw scores map to preference.

members.member: Optional [Curve] or [NNResponseCurve] that shapes the raw [code]0..1[/code] score when [member use_for_scoring] is [code]true[/code].
Whether the last evaluated candidate was filtered out. Set to [code]true[/code] inside [method NNCustomSearchCriterion.on_apply_criterion] to exclude a node.
Score computed for the last evaluated candidate. Set inside [method NNCustomSearchCriterion.on_apply_criterion] for custom scoring.
If [code]true[/code], candidates that fail this criterion are removed from the query results.
If [code]true[/code], this criterion's [member score] contributes to each candidate's total score.
